headlines.title: 이달 1~20일 수출 435억 달러 … 조업일수 감소에도 ‘역대 최대’
headlines.summary: ■ 전년대비 23.5% 증가 설연휴에 조업 2.5일 줄었는데 반도체 수출액 134% 넘게 늘어 설날 연휴로 인한 조업일수 감소에도 불구하고 수출 증가세는 꺾이지 않았다. 반도체가 전체 수출을 강하게 끌어올리면서 매월 1∼20일 기준 최대 수출액을 갈아치웠다.

headlines.title: 이달 1 ∼ 20일 수출 435억달러 ‘ 역대최대 ’… 반도체 134%↑
headlines.summary: 일평균 수출도 47.3% 급증 수입 11.7%↑, 무역흑자 49억弗 이달 1∼20일 우리 수출액이 설 연휴에도 불구 430억달러를 돌파하면서 같은 기간 역대 최대 실적을 기록했다. 인공지능(AI) 수요 확대로 ‘슈퍼사이클’을 타고 있는 반도체 수출이 두 배이상 뛰면서 전체 증가세를 주도했다.

headlines.title: 2월 1~20일 수출 435억 달러 … 역대 최대, 반도체가 이끌었다

headlines.title: 작년 조세부담률 18%대 … 3년 만에 반등에도 OECD 최하위권

headlines.title: 서울 매물 한달새 19% 증가 … 1년 전보단 27% 감소
headlines.summary: 다주택자 압박에 한달새 매물 증가 전년보다 매물 증가, 강남구가 유일 서초·송파 3~20%대 ↓…효과 제한적 정부 “집값 안정” vs 일부 “일시 효과” 정부의 전방위적인 다주택자 압박으로 최근 서울 강남구에선 매물이 늘어나는 등 시장 상황의 변화가 감지된다. 그러나 서울 전체를 볼 땐 1년전보다 매물이 줄었다.

headlines.title: ' 규제지역 아파트 ' 다주택자 대출 회수 초읽기…집값 영향은
headlines.summary: 금융위, 서울·수도권 아파트 다주택자 대출 연장 제한 LTV 0% 적용 속 '단계적 상환' 병행 검토 매물 증가·집값 안정 효과 불투명 금융당국이 서울·수도권 등 규제지역 내 아파트를 보유한 다주택자의 대출 만기 연장 금지를 추진한다. 만기가 도래하는 대출의 연장이나 대환을 신규 대출과 동일한 수준으로 묶어, 사실상 '대출 회수'에 나서는 것이 핵심이다.

headlines.title: ‘ 대출 조이고, 임대는 공공 ’… 생계형 임대사업자 “ 퇴로 절실 ”
headlines.summary: 비거주 다주택자 대출 강화 움직임 임대사업자 35%, 수입 없는 고령층 대출 규제 일괄 적용 땐 생계 위협 정부, 지역·유형 등 ‘핀셋규제’ 할듯 다주택자를 향한 대출 규제 강화 움직임이 본격화하면서, ‘생계형 임대사업자’의 퇴로를 열어줘야 한다는 목소리가 나오고 있다.

key_headlines.title: Government Holds Emergency Market Review, Warns of Persistent Risks
key_headlines.summary: The South Korean government convened an urgent meeting to assess market conditions, emphasizing the existence of persistent risk factors and the need for heightened vigilance.

key_headlines.title: Government: US Mutual Tariff Ruling's Financial Market Impact Limited, Export Conditions to be Protected
key_headlines.summary: Seoul evaluated the US Federal Supreme Court's ruling invalidating mutual tariffs, concluding its financial market impact would be limited, but affirmed its commitment to protecting export conditions.

key_headlines.title: Government to Monitor US Trends Closely to Safeguard National Interest
key_headlines.summary: First Vice Minister Lee Hyung-il chaired a market review, stating the government will closely track US developments to ensure no damage is done to South Korea's balanced interests.

key_headlines.title: US Administration to Maintain Tariffs Despite IEEPA Setback, Citing Alternative Legal Avenues
key_headlines.summary: Despite the US Federal Supreme Court's ruling against mutual tariffs based on the IEEPA, the Trump administration stated its intent to maintain tariffs by leveraging other legal grounds, such as Sections 232 and 301.

key_headlines.title: Government Reiterates Limited Market Impact from US Tariff Ruling, Maintains Vigilance
key_headlines.summary: The Ministry of Economy and Finance reiterated that the US mutual tariff invalidation would have a limited impact on markets but stressed the importance of continuous 24-hour monitoring and vigilance against external risks.

sections.Hot Economy News: The South Korean government held an emergency market review, warning of persistent external risks and emphasizing a need for heightened vigilance. Key discussions centered on the US Federal Supreme Court's ruling invalidating mutual tariffs, with the government assessing its financial market impact as limited. Despite this, Seoul pledged to closely monitor US trends and protect national export conditions and overall economic interests. Meanwhile, the US administration, led by Trump, indicated its intention to maintain tariffs through other legal avenues, such as Sections 232 and 301, despite the setback from the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA). This situation highlights ongoing trade uncertainties and the need for continuous market monitoring.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: Several global economies, including France, the US, and China, are facing credit rating downgrades due to rising fiscal deficits and slowing growth, contrasting with improved debt situations in countries like Italy and Spain. In South Korea, the central bank's key interest rate is widely expected to remain at 3.5% for an extended period, with 99% of bond experts forecasting a freeze on February 26th. This decision is primarily driven by persistent high exchange rates and the anticipation of a continued rate freeze by the US FOMC. Analysts are closely watching for the Bank of Korea's updated growth forecasts, as a significant upward revision could temper expectations for future rate cuts, while core inflation is stable around 2.2%.
sections.Financial Markets: South Korea's financial markets are experiencing a strong uptrend, with the KOSPI index nearing 6000 points, propelled by a semiconductor boom that saw Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix achieve significant milestones. This robust stock market performance is contributing to rising domestic bond yields, even as US Treasury yields remain stable amidst mixed economic data and the prospect of renewed US tariffs. Furthermore, US-listed ETFs focusing on Korea are yielding exceptional returns, with one fund seeing nearly 300% growth in three months. The bond market, however, anticipates an extended period of the Bank of Korea's key interest rate remaining frozen at 3.5%, largely due to persistent high exchange rates and the likely continued freeze by the US Federal Open Market Committee.
sections.Industry & Technology: China has surpassed South Korea in several advanced manufacturing sectors, including robotics, electric vehicles (EVs), and batteries, with South Korea maintaining a lead only in memory semiconductors. A national research institute reported China's dominance also extends to autonomous driving and non-memory semiconductors. Concurrently, the burgeoning EV market is bringing the critical issue of waste battery management to the forefront, with innovative solutions like GS E&C's subsidiary Energy Materials' "discharge-free crushing technology" emerging as potential game-changers. The broader industry sees significant interest and investment in advanced semiconductors, displays, and EV batteries, particularly next-generation solid-state battery technologies, driving strong performance in related equipment stocks.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's housing market is showing signs of cooling, with a 22% increase in property listings and a deceleration in price appreciation, attributed to the government's "war on real estate" policies. A notable transaction saw a prime Seocho-gu apartment sell for significantly less than its peak, as multi-homeowners rush to offload properties to avoid higher capital gains taxes. Meanwhile, the Jeonse (lump-sum deposit lease) market faces a severe shortage of available units, exacerbated by stringent regulations and a shift towards monthly rent. President Lee Jae-myung's month-long crackdown has successfully curbed consumer expectations for rising home prices, and the government is considering measures to protect tenants, such as deferring loan collections for multi-homeowners until lease expiration.
sections.International Economy: The global economic landscape is marked by trade uncertainties, particularly with the US implementing a new 15% global tariff that could impact various countries, potentially benefiting China and Brazil while posing an uncertain outlook for South Korea. The US Federal Reserve's monetary policy remains a key focus, with expectations of interest rates likely staying frozen until at least the end of Chairman Powell's term next year, influenced by mixed economic indicators and the fallout from the mutual tariff invalidation ruling. This ruling has created uncertainty in the interest rate futures market, with investors divided on the timing of potential rate cuts in June or July. Furthermore, President Trump has explicitly warned countries against "playing games" with the US tariff judgment, threatening even higher tariffs.
sections.AI & Economy: The impact of Artificial Intelligence (AI) on the economy presents a complex picture of both optimism and potential risks. Goldman Sachs views AI as a "purely positive" long-term force, enhancing efficiency and productivity across the economy. However, recent analyses, including research from the San Francisco Fed, suggest that a significant portion of current GDP growth is disproportionately driven by data center investments, raising questions about broader economic circulation. A hypothetical scenario even outlines an AI-induced economic collapse where productivity soars, but "ghost GDP" forms as AI agents do not consume, preventing wealth from circulating in the real economy. Concerns also exist that a US-led AI crisis could severely weaken critical growth drivers in global economies, financial markets, corporate earnings, and GDP, given AI's current substantial contribution to growth.
sections.Others: The US Trump administration is reportedly exploring measures to compel banks to collect customer citizenship information, a move aimed at intensifying immigration enforcement. In corporate news, HDC Hyundai EP has appointed Shin Woo-cheol, an experienced professional in advanced materials, as its new CEO. Internationally, the EU is contemplating activating its Anti-Coercion Instrument (ACI) in response to significant trade imbalances, particularly Germany's widening deficit with China. Lastly, Chokwang Paint has reported a substantial operating loss and a shift to deficit, directly impacted by the ongoing slump in the construction industry and a decline in exports.
